recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-41496 unless a later link-checking build reports a new datatype-anchor regression.
issue_request: FHIR-41496 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for R6 asking that bad anchor links around the Quantity section on the datatype examples and main datatype pages be reviewed and corrected.
initial_application: The issue was applied before reconciliation by commit 64a3fffa26689936c243b6aa0d36cf55dbb4cec5, referenced from Jira by HL7/fhir pull request 3898. That commit moved the datatypes-examples.html Quantity anchor from the earlier alias cluster to immediately after the count anchor and immediately before the Quantity heading.
additional_context: The current combined branch contains the historical application commit. source/fhir.ini lists Quantity as an active datatype and maps default datatype pages to datatypes, so source/datatypes.html and source/datatypes-examples.html are current build inputs. Current source/datatypes-examples.html has #Quantity immediately before the Quantity heading after #count, and source/datatypes.html exposes both #Quantity and #quantity before its Quantity heading. Confluence minutes provide only procedural tracker context, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. AutoFHIR published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the Jira request and no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit existed on the combined branch.
